description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ScreenPermissionService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various scenarios for retrieving screen permissions based on roles and screen definitions, using mocking of DAO components and checking permissions logic.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the ScreenPermissionService in the OrangeHRM application, specifically for verifying permission retrieval logic based on different roles and screen configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with a new instance of ScreenPermissionService before each test.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsNoneWithNoScreen
methods.description: Tests scenario where no permissions are defined and the screen does not exist, expecting default permissive resource permission.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsNoneWithScreenDefined
methods.description: Tests scenario where no permissions are defined but a screen exists, expecting restrictive resource permission.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsOne
methods.description: Tests retrieval of permissions when a single user role has specific permissions for a screen.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsTwo
methods.description: Tests permissions retrieval with multiple roles assigned a screen, verifying combined permissions.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsMany
methods.description: Tests permissions retrieval for multiple roles with mixed permission settings, ensuring correct aggregation.

methods.name: testGetScreen
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of a Screen entity based on module and action.

methods.name: verifyPermissions
methods.description: Helper method that asserts the permissions (read, create, update, delete) match expected boolean values.
